en: Hi guys. Hello 7UP.
zh: 嗨，大家好。你好呀，7UP。

en: Are you gonna sit there next to me while I chat?
zh: 我要聊天的时候，你要坐在我旁边吗？

en: I took a little vlog break because.
zh: 我稍微停更了一下vlog，因为

en: life just got a little bit crazy.
zh: 生活突然变得有点乱。

en: But we're back and I wanted to do something different.
zh: 但我们现在回来了，而且我想拍点不一样的东西。

en: Something like, I don't know, just to switch it up.
zh: 就是那种，我也说不好，单纯想换换感觉。

en: I feel like the vlogs can get repetitive.
zh: 我感觉vlog有时候会变得有点重复。

en: but I will get back to them soon.
zh: 不过我很快还是会继续拍的。

en: A lot of you guys wanted like skincare videos, closet videos, fashion stuff.
zh: 很多人想看护肤视频、衣橱视频、时尚相关的内容。

en: But the most asked thing was like.
zh: 但被问得最多的是，

en: you wanted to get to know me better and answer some questions.
zh: 你们想更了解我，也想让我回答一些问题。

en: And there was loads of people asking for a video of Eva and I sitting down like doing our makeup
zh: 还有很多人想看Eva和我坐下来一边化妆一边聊天的视频。

en: so we definitely want to do that at some point.
zh: 所以我们之后肯定想找个时间拍。

en: But I thought tonight I have the evening free.
zh: 不过我想着今晚刚好有空。

en: I thought we could do a little wind down together, evening together.
zh: 我想我们可以一起放松一下，一起度过一个晚上。

en: Just do all the nice things, do some skincare.
zh: 就做一些舒服的小事，护个肤。

en: and then I thought I could answer some questions.
zh: 然后我想我可以回答一些问题。

en: Also on the closet stuff I probably will be moving house soon.
zh: 另外关于衣橱那些内容，我可能很快要搬家了。

en: So I thought I would do a video of.
zh: 所以我想我可以拍一个视频，

en: I love watching people like fill their closets and organise their closets.
zh: 我很喜欢看别人填满自己的衣橱、整理自己的衣橱。

en: So I thought I would do that and I can like show everything in depth
zh: 所以我想我也可以拍这个，而且可以很详细地展示每样东西。

en: when I fill the closet.
zh: 等我整理衣橱的时候再拍。

en: Tonight's plan is I need to take 7UP for a walk who is the recent foster pup.
zh: 今晚的计划是，我需要带7UP去散步，它是最近寄养的小狗。

en: So we'll take him for a walk in a bit.
zh: 所以我们待会儿会带它出去走走。

en: I wanna do some boring things.
zh: 我还想做一些无聊的小事。

en: Put some washing away.
zh: 把洗好的衣服收起来。

en: So yeah I hope you guys enjoy this different kind of video.
zh: 所以希望你们喜欢这种不一样的视频。

en: The first step of the night is the brick.
zh: 今晚的第一步是用这个brick。

en: I'd seen people posting about this on TikTok.
zh: 我之前看到有人在TikTok上发这个。

en: I go through phases with my phone like sometimes.
zh: 我对手机的使用状态会一阵一阵的，比如有时候，

en: I'm really in the swing of not scrolling too much.
zh: 我真的很能控制自己，不会刷太多。

en: I'm really good in the evenings and the mornings.
zh: 晚上和早上我都做得挺好。

en: Don't check my notifications first thing.
zh: 不会一醒来第一件事就看通知。

en: But it's an addiction.
zh: 但这真的是一种上瘾。

en: You just, it's like muscle memory of switching between the apps.
zh: 你就是会像肌肉记忆一样，在各种app之间切来切去。

en: I don't have to explain it.
zh: 我都不用解释。

en: We all are addicted.
zh: 我们大家都上瘾了。

en: The people that have had one all were saying they've had the best experiences.
zh: 那些用过这个东西的人都说体验特别好。

en: And that having something physical instead of these like.
zh: 而且比起那些，嗯，

en: apps that just block your social media was so much better.
zh: 单纯屏蔽社交媒体的app，有一个实体的东西要好得多。

en: So I'm gonna give it a try.
zh: 所以我打算试试看。

en: Basically you tap your phone on the brick.
zh: 基本上，你把手机在这个brick上碰一下。

en: and it blocks whatever apps you pick for it to block.
zh: 它就会屏蔽你自己选择要屏蔽的那些app。

en: So I've done Instagram, TikTok, all the socials.
zh: 所以我设置了Instagram、TikTok，还有所有社交软件。

en: I've also blocked YouTube.
zh: 我还屏蔽了YouTube。

en: Yeah I've blocked them all.
zh: 对，我全都屏蔽了。

en: So I'm gonna try it for the first time tonight.
zh: 所以今晚我要第一次试试看。

en: And you can set yourself like a schedule.
zh: 而且你可以给自己设置一个时间表。

en: and if you don't have the brick you can't unlock your apps.
zh: 如果你没有这个brick，就没法解锁你的app。

en: I mean there's like an emergency unlock but.
zh: 我是说，也有那种紧急解锁功能，不过

en: I think it's like you can only do it a certain amount of times which helps but...
zh: 我觉得好像只能用有限的次数，这点还挺有帮助的，但是……

en: Okay here we go.
zh: 好，开始吧。

en: I think this is what I do.
zh: 我觉得应该是这样操作。

en: Woohoo! Okay time for a walk.
zh: 耶！好啦，该去散步了。
